1.0 INTRODUCTION:

1.1 To define and display the services provided by the hospital and ensure that the staff are oriented to these.

2.0 SCOPE:

2.1 Hospital Management

2.2 Health Care Providers

2.3 Patients

3.0 RESPONSIBILITY:

3.1 Doctors, Hospital Management

3.2 Hospital staff

4.0 ABBREVIATIONS:

4.1 AAC -Access Assessment and Continuity of Care

5.0 DEFINITION: Nil

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards for Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1 The services being provided are clearly defined and align with the needs of the community.

7.2 The defined services are prominently displayed.

7.3 The staff is oriented to these services.

8. 0 PROCESSES

8.1 The following are the services provided at Shree Vishwagovind Ayurvedic And Panchkarma Centre.

1. Front office Registration, Enquiry, Billing and Accounts

2. Dispensary

3. Emergency

4. Outpatient

5. Human resources

6. Quality Department

7. Information Technology

8. Maintenance

9. Bio Medical

10. Housekeeping

11. Medical Record

12. Nursing

13. Hospital Infection Control

14. Kayachikitsa

15. Panchakarma

16. Speciality OPD

17. Day care

18. Wards

19. Outreach Activities

8.2 DISPLAY OF SERVICES

8.2.1 The services provided by the hospital are displayed prominently in the language of English and Marathi

8.2.2 The details of services provided are displayed in an area visible to patients and family members while entering respective facilities/areas.

8.2.3 Hospital AO is responsible for identifying the requirement of signage boards, to provide the same and rectify in case of any damage. The tariff for rooms and other basic hospital services is available at the front office.

8.3 STAFF ORIENTATION

8.3.1 The staff of Help Desk, Admission Counter, Billing, Outpatient department, Diagnostics and Causality are to be trained, Joining of New staff, Changes/updates of tariff services/policy.

8.3.2 If identified, any lack of awareness of staff through observation/complaints. The relevant staff are oriented on the services provided by the hospital, either through training programs or by reading this document, as appropriate, and the same to be recorded in training record form.
